newsitem.title: USA: Transcor Waste names Ira Cohen president.
newsitem.headline: Transcor Waste names Ira Cohen president.

text.p: TransCor Waste Services Inc said on Monday that the company had Ira Cohen president of the company and its Kimmins Recycling subsidiary.
The appointment was made on July 15, Transcor said.

Regarding the delay in announcing Cohen's appointment, a company spokeswoman said Transcor had a policy of making sure that its top executives were able to fulfill the company's expectations before issuing any announcement.
Francis Williams continues to serve as chairman after dropping the title of president.
Before joining Transcor, Cohen was chief operating officer of solid waste collection, recycling and disposal companies in Wisconsin and Illinois.
Kimmins Corp owns 74 percent of TransCor Waste Services Inc.
